title: P1-A AI streaming chat tail-follow 20ms

phases.label: Stream 800 markdown/code/tool-output tokens at 20ms while remaining tail-followed
Keep the page foreground-active after the stream completes

sop: Load the P1-A target and confirm the visible audit state shows ready=true and idle_ms is increasing before the run starts.
Confirm baseline_id, scenario_mode=tail-follow, history_messages=160, stream_tokens=800, and token_interval_ms=20.
Press Enter only after the history is mounted and has been idle for at least 2 seconds.
Do not interact with the page during capture; the target starts streaming when it observes p0:capture:start.
Keep the Chrome window foreground-active for the full 45 second capture window.
